text: No. 18-10/2017-IP Government of India Ministry of Communications Department of Telecommunications New Delhi, 27 September, 2021 OFFICE MEMORANDUM Subject: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017- Notification of Telecom Goods, Services or Works - regarding. Notification No. 18-10/2017-IP dated 31.08.2021 issued by Department of Telecommunications is kept in abeyance till further orders. To: 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. 7. 8. 9. All Ministries/ Departments of Government of India. (Rajesh Kumar Sahu) Director{IP) Cabinet Secretariat / PMO / NITI Aayog / Comptroller & Auditor General of India. PS to Hon' ble Minister of Communications. PS to Hon' ble Minister of State for Communications. PPS to Secretary (Telecom)/Additional Secretary (T)/Administrator, USOF. PPS to Member (T) / Member(S) / Member(F) / Advisor(T) / Advisor(O) / Wireless Advisor. Sr. DOG, TEC, Khurshid Lal Bhawan, New Delhi. JS (A)/JS (T)/CVO/All DDGs. All PSUs/Autonomous bodies under Department of Telecommunications. z-(Rajesh Kumar Sahu} Director{IP) -- 1 of 1 --
